name: @sdkurjnk/blackshell
description: Build-stage protection tool that seals critical code regions at the compiler IR level, communicating with the outside only by value.

scripts.build:engine: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true})" && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -o build/blackshell-engine src/engine/main.cpp src/engine/driver.cpp src/engine/frontend.cpp src/engine/gate.cpp src/engine/noising.cpp src/engine/harness.cpp src/engine/backend.cpp
scripts.build:engine-test: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true})" && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -I src/engine -o build/blackshell-engine-test test/engine/engine_test.cpp src/engine/driver.cpp src/engine/frontend.cpp src/engine/gate.cpp src/engine/noising.cpp src/engine/harness.cpp src/engine/backend.cpp
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:ts
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:engine-test
